# Web parity gate (WEBP-9). One line per laptop palette command or activity view.
# kind <TAB> id <TAB> detail. Sorted inside each kind. Reviewed by hand: a new laptop id
# must be added to exactly one kind, or TestWebParityGate fails.
#
# web      id  ref    the web does it: palette (web allow-list), op:<webproto op>, cmd:<workbench command id>, view:<activity id>
# excluded id  reason why the web will never have it (one line)
# missing  id  area|size  a gap the web should close; NOT an exclusion
